name: Liu 2017 He-4 open-cycle JT, last stage at 17.3 K

reference.citation: Liu D, Gan Z, de Waele ATAM, Tao X, Yao Y. Temperature and mass-flow behavior of a He-4 Joule-Thomson cryocooler. Int J Heat Mass Transf 109 (2017) 1094-1099
reference.location: Sec. 2.2 / Eq. (1): Ta = 17.3 K, 1.137 / 0.104 MPa, mdot 9.1 mg/s, Qmax = 52.5 mW (theory), 48.9-49.4 mW measured
reference.note: T_C is T_sat(0.104 MPa) = 4.2517 K. Last-CHEX effectiveness 0.9857 is DERIVED from the paper's Eq. (1), which has the return gas leaving CFHX3 at 17.1 K while the supply enters at 17.3 K (eta = (h(P_L,17.1 K) - h_g)/(h(P_L,17.3 K) - h_g)). T_pre1 = 60 K and eta1 = eta2 = 1 are PLACEHOLDERS (not given); they do not affect q_C, mdot or Q_C. Reported Q_C is their calculated Q_max (52.5 mW); measured Q_max is 48.9-49.4 mW (the ~3.6 mW difference is heat leak).
